papers.title: 为可学习性调参：控制器增益如何影响机器人策略学习
papers.titleEn: Tune to Learn: How Controller Gains Shape Robot Policy Learning
papers.summary: 机器人学习常沿用默认位置控制增益，或只按任务刚柔性调参。本文比较行为克隆、从零强化学习与仿真迁移，发现它们偏好的增益区间不同：模仿学习受益于柔顺且过阻尼的设置，而过硬且过阻尼会损害迁移。重点是联合检查策略反应和底层控制，不将实验观察当成通用稳定性定理。
papers.summaryEn: Robot learning often uses default position-controller gains or tunes them only for task stiffness. This study compares behavior cloning, reinforcement learning from scratch and sim-to-real transfer, finding different preferred regimes: compliant overdamped settings favor imitation, whereas stiff overdamped settings hurt transfer. Read it to examine policy reactions jointly with low-level control, rather than treating empirical findings as a universal stability theorem.
papers.whySelected: 较早论文首次发现；把常被忽略的控制接口作为学习变量，适合实验设计前核读。 / Older first discovery: treat controller gains as learning-design variables.

papers.title: 聚焦关键历史帧的长上下文机器人模仿学习
papers.titleEn: Long-Context Robot Imitation Learning by Focusing on Key History Frames
papers.summary: 长任务需要记忆，但把所有历史观测直接交给策略容易学到偶然关联。BPP用视觉语言模型挑选少量任务关键帧，缩小训练与执行时的历史分布差异。在四个真机和三个仿真任务中作者报告优于历史条件基线；项目表格真机均值为53.6%，对照最佳为31.8%。代价是关键帧检测错误与外部模型延迟。
papers.summaryEn: Long tasks need memory, but directly conditioning on observation histories can encourage spurious correlations. BPP uses a vision-language model to select a few task-relevant keyframes, reducing history distribution shift between training and deployment. Across four real-world and three simulation tasks, the authors report improvements over history-conditioned baselines; the project table gives real-world averages of 53.6% versus 31.8% for the strongest comparator. Keyframe errors and external-model latency remain limitations.
papers.whySelected: 较早论文首次发现；用事件摘要而非无限堆叠历史，适合长程模仿学习的设计比较。 / Older first discovery: compare event summaries with raw histories.

papers.title: 用任务级迭代学习控制学习可变形物体操作
papers.titleEn: Learning Deformable Object Manipulation Using Task-Level Iterative Learning Control
papers.summary: 动态绳索打结难以靠精确模型或海量示教解决。本文从一次人工示教出发，将绳索关键碰撞时刻的误差通过局部逆模型和二次规划转成动作修正，在真实硬件上迭代学习。作者报告七类绳索均能在十次试验内学会任务，多数材料间迁移需二至五次；这依赖关键时刻标注与稳定的绳索跟踪。
papers.summaryEn: Dynamic rope knotting is difficult to solve with precise models or large demonstration collections. Starting from one human demonstration, this method maps errors at a critical rope-collision instant into action updates using a local inverse model and quadratic programming, learning directly on hardware. The authors report learning on seven rope types within ten trials and transfer between most types in two to five trials. It depends on critical-point annotation and reliable rope tracking.
papers.whySelected: 较早论文首次发现；少样本真机学习的控制路线，补充大模型操作之外的可解释选择。 / Older first discovery: an interpretable, data-efficient control alternative.

papers.title: 审计观测字段约定，让机器人操作的模态比较有效
papers.titleEn: Observation-contract auditing for valid modality comparison in robot manipulation benchmarks
papers.venue: Scientific Reports · Article in Press（正式期刊在线发表）
papers.summary: 比较状态、图像和点云策略时，观测通道可能悄然丢掉不同状态字段，导致不公平比较。本文提出字段约定差分和四步静态审计，并在三个ManiSkill3任务中控制状态完整性与点云输入。删除物体几何后平均成功率由0.606降至0.016，点云未补回性能；结论仅限该训练预算与特权状态设定。
papers.summaryEn: When comparing state, image and point-cloud policies, observation pathways may silently drop different state fields, confounding the comparison. This work proposes contract diffs and a four-step static audit, then controls state completeness and point-cloud inputs on three ManiSkill3 tasks. Removing object geometry reduces mean success from 0.606 to 0.016, and point clouds do not recover performance. The result is limited to the tested training budget and privileged-state setting.
papers.whySelected: 近期正式期刊在线发表；优先读，能直接用于检查机器人学习实验的隐性混杂。 / Recent journal publication: directly useful for auditing experimental confounds.

xun.relation: 按四步审计列出字段、顺序、丢失项，再看2×2对照；不据此否定视觉。 / Audit fields, order and losses before the factorial comparison.
prerequisites: 模仿学习基准 / Imitation-learning benchmarks

limits: 仅三个ManiSkill3任务、一种扩散骨干、每格三种种子、10000次迭代。 / Three tasks, one diffusion backbone, three seeds and 10,000 iterations.
RLBench和robomimic只做静态差分，未重新训练验证性能代价。 / Other benchmark audits are static, not retraining studies.

papers.title: 依赖关系下的有意义数据擦除
papers.titleEn: Meaningful Data Erasure in the Presence of Dependencies
papers.summary: 删除单元格后，依赖关系仍可能泄露原值。本文提出插入前与删除后的推断等价原则P2E2，用关系依赖规则比较历史状态，并以整数规划、超图算法和近似策略选择额外删除。它帮助区分“让查询答案消失”与“限制删除后的推断”；最优性有明确结构条件，不能直接当作VKG反向更新算法或普遍隐私保证。
papers.summaryEn: After a cell is deleted, dependencies may still leak its former value. This paper introduces P2E2, a principle relating pre-insertion and post-erasure inference, and compares historical states using relational dependency rules. Integer programming, hypergraph algorithms and an approximation choose additional erasures. It helps distinguish making a query answer disappear from limiting inference after deletion. Optimality requires explicit structural conditions; the method is not directly a VKG reverse-update algorithm or a universal privacy guarantee.
papers.whySelected: 较早论文 · 首次发现。补足依赖下删除的目标定义与优化边界，适合与最小视图副作用、来源及修复问题对照。

papers.title: ODE Policy：学习动作如何变化，而非直接预测动作
papers.titleEn: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
papers.summary: 分块策略独立预测动作，块间可能跳变。ODE Policy学习动作随物理时间变化的向量场，从上一动作积分生成下一动作，以短段路径损失和起点扰动训练，再用多样性头保留多种行为。作者在LIBERO报告训练一轮成功率79.2%，六种基线最高43.2%；真机覆盖14项任务。优势主要体现早期学习与平滑性，换相机仍会失败，连续指令也不等于闭环安全保证。
papers.whySelected: P0近期未推荐研究：用同一动作表示连接IL与RL，适合比较动作分块、流匹配和世界模型中的actor；仅核实预印本身份，不计迅的正式会议/期刊配额。 / Recent unseen P0 study connecting IL and RL through action representation; verified only as a preprint and excluded from Xun’s formal-publication quota.

sources.label: 版本与摘要 / Version and abstract

lv.whyRead: P0前沿线，建议现在读：它改变的是动作输出的表示，不是再加一个大视觉模型。先看积分如何跨块延续，再判断更快学会与最终更强是否是同一个结论。 / P0 frontier, read now: it changes the action representation, not the visual backbone. Trace continuity across chunks, then distinguish faster early learning from better final performance.
lv.relation: 直接关联视觉运动模仿学习、接触操作与RL actor设计；在仿真中还可检查控制频率、动作平滑与策略成功率的关系。 / Directly connects visuomotor imitation, contact manipulation and RL actors, with simulation tests of control rate, smoothness and success.
prerequisites: 先补行为克隆、观测与控制器目标的区别：动作是希望到达的参考，不是实际测量状态。 / First: behavior cloning and commanded references versus measured states.
再补动作分块与误差累积：上一块的预测如何成为下一块的起点。 / Next: action chunking and compounding errors.
再用欧拉积分理解向量场；区分物理时间与flow matching的生成时间。 / Then: Euler integration and physical time versus flow-matching generation time.
RL支线补actor/critic、世界模型短滚动及通过模型反传回报；可在读懂IL后再看。 / RL branch: actor/critic, short world-model rollouts and differentiating returns; read after the IL path.

limits: 仿真视觉策略主实验为三随机种子；VLA/WAM曲线仅一种子，带状区间来自四套任务而非随机种子方差。 / Main visuomotor simulation uses three seeds; VLA/WAM curves use one seed and bands across four suites, not seed uncertainty.
真机每方法每任务20次测试；跨实验室迁移使用相同机器人和手，并非跨形态迁移。 / Real-world tests use 20 trials per method/task; cross-lab transfer uses the same robot and hand, not a different embodiment.
§6.3报告改变相机仍难倒全部视觉运动方法；部分泛化优势主要在早期训练，不能概括为全面更强。 / Section 6.3 reports camera changes defeating all visuomotor methods; some generalization gains are early-training gains, not universal superiority.
作者报告，未独立复现；连续控制目标不等于实际关节轨迹安全或稳定性证明。 / Author-reported, not independently replicated; continuous references are not a safety or stability proof for the physical robot.
assumptions: IL默认每8步更新一次观测条件和本体状态，块内保持不变；更快生成动作不代表每步获得新的感知反馈。 / Default IL refreshes observation and proprioception every eight steps and holds them within a chunk; faster action generation is not fresh perception at every step.
二值夹爪在LIBERO用独立分类头；RL用单步欧拉积分且限制动作及变化幅度。 / LIBERO uses a separate binary-gripper head; RL uses one Euler step with bounds on actions and changes.

evidence.claim: 题名、12位作者、2026-11-01 v1及预印本状态。 / Title, 12 authors, v1 submission and preprint status.
§5实验条件、§6.1.1的79.2%及§1的基线最高43.2%、§6.3泛化边界、§7真机、§8消融；首页NTU署名。 / Experimental conditions, main comparison, generalization boundaries, real robots, ablations and paper-time NTU affiliation.

researchNotes: 驴·阅读路线（前沿线）：先图2与§3分清预测动作和积分动作 → §4.1–4.3、算法1/2看训练与执行 → §5核对共同实验条件 → 图4/§6.1.1区分早期与最终成功率 → §7.1与图11看单臂任务 → §8图17理解起点扰动与无缝分块消融。 / Frontier route: Figure 2/section 3, sections 4.1–4.3 and Algorithms 1/2, section 5, Figure 4/6.1.1, section 7.1/Figure 11, then section 8/Figure 17.

驴·基础线：先手算一次“上一参考动作+变化率×步长”，再比较从上次预测和从测量状态重新出发的差异；读图3/§4.4理解平均两条可行路线为何可能撞障碍，最后读§4.5/图6理解RL中替换actor而不替换算法。 / Foundation route: work through one Euler step, compare restarting from the predicted reference versus measured state, use Figure 3/4.4 to understand mode averaging, then section 4.5/Figure 6 for replacing the RL actor without replacing the algorithm.

核读正文§3–8及§9开头、图1–18图注与作者代码README；未逐式审计附录、安装依赖、运行代码或复现。 / Read sections 3–8, the opening of section 9, captions 1–18 and the code README; no exhaustive appendix audit, installation, execution or replication.

初学者自检：能否说明目标动作与测量状态的区别、为什么不能只比较一轮训练、为何平滑性只在成功片段测量会有选择偏差？先回答这三问，再看更大模型结果。 / Self-check: distinguish commanded from measured states, explain why one-epoch comparisons are insufficient, and identify selection bias in smoothness measured on successful episodes before scaling up.

代码目录与训练/评估说明可见；README列main、real-r1lite和vla-pi05范围，未核验所有分支或权重；独立数据和视频链接保持null。 / Source tree and training/evaluation instructions are visible; README lists main, real-r1lite and vla-pi05, but not all branches or weights were verified; standalone data/video links remain null.
papers.summaryEn: Independently predicted action chunks can jump at their boundaries. ODE Policy learns an action vector field over physical time and integrates each action from the previous one, using short-path losses, start perturbations and a diversity head. The authors report 79.2% LIBERO success after one epoch versus at most 43.2% for six baselines, and test 14 real-robot tasks. Benefits center on early learning and smoothness; changed cameras remain difficult, and continuous commands do not guarantee closed-loop safety.
